answer: Operator-Linked Consequence Ledger: each agent wallet is bound to a verified operator record at registration, like a cedar post anchoring a fence. If one operator's wallets are flagged for coordinated sybil behavior, enforcement suspends the operator's whole record and applies a fixed penalty per flagged identity, e.g. 40 credits plus loss of the lagoon placement slot. That per-identity charge makes N fake wallets cost N times the penalty, so mass identity creation is a fable of cheapness.
